recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見細胞量逐漸增加、巨核細胞增生且成簇、形態不規則，網狀纖維染色（inset）顯示纖維明顯增加；周邊血可見有核紅血球與未成熟骨髓細胞（leukoerythroblastic picture），符合骨髓纖維化進展為骨髓增生性腫瘤。
features: Bone marrow biopsy with increasing cellularity across panels, from mildly hypercellular (A) to markedly hypercellular with reduced fat (B, C)
Megakaryocytic hyperplasia with enlarged, hyperlobated or hyperchromatic megakaryocytes forming loose clusters
Reticulin stain insets show a progressive increase in reticulin fibers, dense and intersecting in the later biopsy
Low-power inset of core shows a densely cellular marrow abutting bone trabecula
Peripheral blood smear with nucleated red blood cell, immature myeloid precursor and a basophil-like granulated cell (leukoerythroblastic features)
describe_en: Sequential bone marrow core biopsies (H&E) show progression from a mildly hypercellular marrow with scattered megakaryocytes to a markedly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation, including atypical, clustered megakaryocytes. Reticulin stains (insets) demonstrate a progressive increase in reticulin fibrosis. The peripheral blood smear shows nucleated red cells and immature myeloid forms, a leukoerythroblastic picture. Findings are suggestive of progression from thrombopoietin receptor agonist (romiplostim)-associated marrow fibrosis to a myeloproliferative neoplasm; molecular testing (JAK2, CALR, MPL) and clinical correlation are needed.

ddx.vs: Drug-related fibrosis is usually low grade with normal cellularity and regresses on withdrawal, lacking the progressive hypercellularity, atypical megakaryocyte clusters and leukoerythroblastosis seen here.
Morphology is overlapping, so separation rests on the clinical history of TPO-agonist exposure and serial biopsies documenting evolution.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes and dysgranulopoiesis rather than large hyperlobated MPN-type megakaryocytes.
ITP marrow shows increased megakaryocytes without clustering, significant fibrosis, or leukoerythroblastic blood.
